en.title: Adverbs of place
en.summary: Adverbs of place tell where something happens.

paragraphs: Adverbs of place tell where something happens or in which direction. They answer the question where? They include words for position (here, there, nearby), direction (up, down, away) and indefinite places (somewhere, everywhere, nowhere).

Adverbs of place usually follow the verb or its object. They do not take a preposition, so we say go home, not go to home. Here and there often begin a sentence for emphasis: Here comes the bus. When the subject is a noun, it follows the verb; when it is a pronoun, it comes first: Here it comes.

blocks.html:
AdverbExample
here, therePut it here.
inside, outsideWait outside.
upstairs, downstairsHe is upstairs.
somewhere, nowhereIt must be somewhere.
away, backShe went away. He came back.

paragraphs: When a sentence has both an adverb of place and an adverb of time, the usual order is place, then time: We met here yesterday. Manner usually comes first of all: She sang beautifully there last night.
Home is an adverb after verbs of movement: go home, come home, get home. It is a noun after prepositions: at home, from home. We say I am at home, and I am going home.

items: Wrong: **I go to home.** Right: **I go home.**
Wrong: **He is in the upstairs.** Right: **He is upstairs.**
Wrong: **There comes it.** Right: **There it comes.**

ro.title: Adverbe de loc
ro.summary: Adverbele de loc arată unde se petrece o acțiune și răspund la întrebarea „unde?”.

paragraphs: Adverbele de loc arată unde se întâmplă o acțiune. Ele răspund la întrebarea „unde?”. Folosim aceste cuvinte foarte des în conversațiile zilnice.
În limba română, adverbul de loc stă de obicei după verb. Uneori îl putem pune la începutul propoziției pentru accentuare. Forma adverbului nu se schimbă niciodată.

blocks.html:
AdverbExemplu
aiciTrenul oprește **aici**.
acoloPrietenul meu locuiește **acolo**.
aproapeȘcoala este **aproape**.
departeNoi mergem **departe**.
susCartea se află **sus**.
